bds.lede: After a 13-year wait, one of entertainment’s biggest releases is finally here.
rows: The long-awaited "Grand Theft Auto VI" was released Thursday, with fans swarming to get in on the action. Kelly O'Grady reports.

Lee Stewart and all his staff are taking a vacation from the chilly autumn streets of Winnipeg and heading for the sunny coast of Vice City, the fictitious setting of the latest Rockstar Games release, Grand Theft Auto VI. They're far from alone.
The series lets players live out gangster fantasies, smash up cars and fight whoever they choose in a fictionalised US city populated by lowlifes, sex workers and thugs.
After a 13-year wait, one of entertainment’s biggest releases is finally here.
Grand Theft Auto VI, one of the most anticipated video games ever, goes live Thursday.
